opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Proposals must address one or more of the priority questions, have a clear path to impact, a rigorous methodology, and appropriate experience and expertise.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the priority questions outlined in the Nuffield Foundation's Strategic Review.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research on racial diversity within the UK, particularly focusing on racial inequalities, discrimination, and pathways to racial justice.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on racial inequalities, discrimination, and pathways to racial justice.

opportunities.title: UK impacts of the US-Iran conflict

amount.raw: Up to eight projects, with a total funding budget of up to £300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations, including universities, research institutes, think tanks, policy institutes, research consultancies, and other organisations with relevant expertise and analytical capacity.
opportunities.summary: Rapid response research funding to understand the economic and social impacts on the UK of the 2026 conflict involving US, Iran, Israel and the wider region.
